name: Macy's American Express® Card
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, but the everyday earning rate depends heavily on which Star Rewards tier you're in
balance_transfer_apr: 32.99%, for balance transfers completed within 4 months of account opening
balance_transfer_fee: The greater of $10 or 5% of the amount of each transfer
late_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another late payment occurs within 6 billing cycles
returned_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another returned payment occurs within 6 billing cycles

welcome_bonus.bonus: 30% off macys.com purchases (20% in store), up to $100 in total savings
welcome_bonus.requirement: on purchases the day you're approved for a Macy's card; needs instant approval and doesn't apply to upgrades

verdict.text: Only strong for frequent Macy's shoppers who reach Platinum status

earn_rates.category: Macy's & macys.com: Platinum tier ($1,200+ a year at Macy's with the card)
Macy's & macys.com: Gold tier ($500 to $1,199 a year at Macy's with the card)
Macy's & macys.com: Silver tier (every new card starts here)

earn_note: This is the open-loop American Express version of Macy's card: it earns outside Macy's, unlike the closed-loop, store-only Macy's Credit Card, which only works at Macy's and Macy's Backstage. Every new card starts at Silver, which earns 2 points per $1 at Macy's. Gold ($500 to $1,199 a year) earns 3 and Platinum ($1,200+) earns 5. Only spend at Macy's with the card counts toward a tier, not spend elsewhere on the Amex. Star Money Bonus Days add extra points on top of these rates. The 3%/2%/1% rates outside Macy's don't vary by tier.

redemption_options.method: Star Money statement credit / merchandise certificate at Macy's, issued from accumulated points

points.note: 1,000 points = $10 in Star Money. Star Money expires 30 days after it's issued, so it has to be used quickly rather than banked. It can be spent at Macy's, Macy's Backstage and macys.com, but not on gift cards, services or a card payment. All points and unused Star Money are forfeited if you go 12 months in a row without a qualifying purchase.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: Star Money redeems only at Macy's and macys.com.

insurance.detail: Not confirmed on Citi's or Macy's public product pages for this card
Not confirmed on Citi's or Macy's public product pages for this card

protection_note: Despite running on the American Express network, this is a Citi-issued retail co-brand, not an Amex-issued card, so Amex's own purchase protection and extended warranty don't apply. No Guide to Benefits for this card was found. Treat it as a rewards-and-financing card with no insurance you can count on.
rental_note: No rental car coverage found for this card.

status_perks.name: Star Rewards tiers
status_perks.note: Silver (default), then Gold at $500 a year and Platinum at $1,200, counting only spend at Macy's with the card. Every tier earns on everyday Macy's purchases (2, 3 or 5 points per $1), and Star Money Bonus Days add more.

services.name: No foreign transaction fees on the store card; 3% on the Amex version
services.detail: This open-loop Amex version charges a 3% foreign transaction fee on purchases made outside the US, a real cost if you'd use it while traveling.

services.name: Special financing offers
services.detail: Deferred-interest/promotional financing periodically offered on qualifying Macy's purchases. Using it can affect reward-earning on that purchase; check current terms before financing.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns rewards on their spend (into your account)
No dedicated insurance to share: this card doesn't carry a confirmed protection suite

additional_cards.note: Free to add, useful mainly for pooling a household's Macy's spend toward reaching Platinum tier faster.

timeline.text: Macy's/Citi (via Department Stores National Bank, a Citi subsidiary) issue two distinct card products: the closed-loop, store-only Macy's Credit Card (Star Rewards only, unusable outside Macy's/Backstage) and this open-loop Macy's American Express Card (same Star Rewards structure at Macy's, plus 3%/2%/1% elsewhere). Confirm which one you're comparing; they are not the same card.
